name: WA Hardship Utility Grant Scheme (HUGS)
summary: Grant towards overdue utility bills for Western Australians in financial hardship who set up a payment arrangement.
key: South of the 26th parallel, you may be eligible for up to $640 per financial year; north of the 26th parallel, up to $1,060 per financial year.
who: Assessed by your utility provider as being in financial hardship
Enter into a payment arrangement for at least 90 days
Outstanding bill still over $300 after that arrangement
how: Start with your utility provider, which assesses you and sets up a payment arrangement.
The HUGS Service Centre then reviews your case and the Department of Communities decides.
catches: The grant must not exceed 85% of the amount outstanding on your utility account.
A Health Care Card is not required.
